en.headline: Hang Seng Index closes down 241 points as tech shares slide
en.dek: The benchmark fell 0.98 per cent to 24,315.92, with the Hang Seng Tech Index down 1.41 per cent amid pressure from higher US inflation expectations.
body: Hong Kong's stock market ended lower on Wednesday, with the Hang Seng Index down 241.12 points, or 0.98 per cent, to close at 24,315.92.

The Hang Seng China Enterprises Index dropped 1.14 per cent to 8,171.45, while the Hang Seng Tech Index slid 1.41 per cent. Mainland markets fared better, with the Shanghai Composite Index closing up 0.5 per cent and the Shenzhen Component Index up 1.32 per cent, led by technology shares.

Traders cited pressure from a hotter-than-expected US consumer inflation reading and rising bets on further Federal Reserve rate hikes, which lifted global bond yields and the dollar. Regional markets were mixed, with South Korea's Kospi rising sharply on chip stocks while Hong Kong lagged.

zh.headline: 恒生指數收市跌241點 科技股拖累
zh.dek: 恒指全日跌0.98%報24315.92點，恒生科技指數跌1.41%，市場受美國通脹數據高於預期影響。
body: 港股周三收市回軟，恒生指數下跌241.12點，或0.98%，收報24315.92點。
恒生中國企業指數下跌1.14%至8171.45點，恒生科技指數下跌1.41%。內地股市則較為穩健，上證指數收升0.5%，深證成指升1.32%，科技股帶動升幅。
市場人士指出，美國消費物價指數高於預期，令投資者上調聯儲局加息預期，全球債息上升及美元轉強，對港股構成壓力。區內股市表現參差，南韓股市受晶片股帶動大升，港股則相對落後。
